title: Subclass parser drops sub-subsection prose (Tenets of Devotion, etc.)
description: Found during eshyra-4a7.6 PR2 source-coverage closure. The subclass body parser emits the subclass intro paragraph and the per-level subclass FEATURE records, but drops leaf sub-subsection prose that is neither the intro nor a granted feature. Confirmed dropped: the Oath of Devotion's 'Tenets of Devotion' (Honesty, Courage, Compassion, Honor, Duty) is in no emitted record description. Sub-subsection HEADINGS that introduce emitted spell tables (Paladin 'Oath Spells' p33 -> table:oath-of-devotion-spells, Warlock 'Expanded Spell List' p50 -> table:fiend-expanded-spells) are accounted as ignore:subclass-spell-table-heading (table emitted + linked via subclass.data.spellTableRefs). 'Tenets of Devotion' has no such table and is held under a narrow known-gap naming THIS bead. Fix: capture sub-subsection prose into subclass description (or structured field), remove the narrow known-gap, audit other subclasses.
acceptance_criteria: Tenets of Devotion prose represented on subclass:oath-of-devotion; narrow known-gap removed; other subclasses audited.
close_reason: Subclass namedSections mechanism captures Tenets of Devotion as data.sections on subclass:oath-of-devotion. known-gap:eshyra-citg removed. All tests pass. PR #207 open.
